facts.business: Dhvija Finance Limited (formerly F Mec International Financial Services Limited) is a non-deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI, providing digital retail lending solutions including personal loans and salary advance products to individuals, salaried professionals, MSMEs and businesses across urban and semi-urban India.
